property_summary: The transfer function should return true when the token transfer succeeds.
The return value of transfer is true when all internal calls succeed.
The transfer function should only succeed if the recipient address can receive tokens via transferFrom, not via transfer
The transfer function should only succeed when the to addresses can receive tokens via transferFrom from the from address
The transfer function should always use the transferFrom selector (0x23b872dd), not the transfer selector (0xa9059cbb).
After calling transfer, the function must always return true.
The transfer function must revert if any of the recipient addresses is the zero address (i.e., address(0)).
The transfer function should not revert for any valid input array of non-zero length and any address parameters.
The transfer function must not revert when called with a valid input array of non-zero length and any address parameters.
For any call to C.transfer that does not revert, the return value is always true.
The transfer function must not revert when called with a non-empty array of addresses.
The return value of transfer is always true when it does not revert.
All individual token transfers called within transfer() must succeed for the transaction to succeed.
After calling transfer, the total balance of all recipients increases by exactly the number of recipients times v (not v+1).
After calling transfer, the sum of (balance of each recipient before call) plus v equals the sum of (balance of each recipient after call).
After a call to transfer, the balance of each recipient increases by exactly v (not v+1).
After calling transfer, the sum of the balances of all recipients increases by exactly v times the number of recipients.
After calling transfer, the return value of the call to transferFrom on the token contract is true.
The sum of balances of all to addresses after transfer is equal to the product of v and the length of _tos
After a call to transfer, the Ether balance of caddress increases by v * _tos.length, as each transferFrom call should send v wei from from to _tos[i].
The return value of transfer is always true.
After a call to transfer, the contract's own Ether balance remains unchanged.
Calling transfer with any valid parameters never reverts on the reference contract.
